summary: Close to implementable: the secret store, CLI and Graph authentication are specified in detail; the biggest gaps are how sink instances fit the binding envelope and how config files pair with installed plugins.

questions.text: Do sink connector instances also declare a binding and get a generated Kyyn.Connectors handle, given KB tools cannot call sinks?
questions.reason: Fixes the persisted config envelope and binding namespace; 0016's envelope is uniformly '{ name, binding, connector }' while 0009 excludes sinks from KB tools.

questions.text: Is a config file required for every installed plugin, and is a config file for an uninstalled plugin an error?
questions.reason: Decides whether a fresh install or a removal leaves a valid root; 0016 says 'Installation creates no instances' and malformed config fails preparation, but says nothing about absent or orphaned files.

questions.text: What is the shape of LoginError, and how do login outcomes (unsupported, denied, expired, provider error) map to CLI outcomes and exit codes?
questions.reason: The generated login adapter needs its codec; 0016 gives 'login :: Config -> PluginLogin (Either LoginError ())' and 'denial/expiry stop with an actionable diagnostic' only.

questions.text: How does a diagnostic locate a configuration error by plugin and instance, given DiagnosticLocation has only fact, source and example cases?
questions.reason: May require a new case in the shared SDK type and wire codec; 0016 requires 'diagnostics identifying plugin and instance', 0011 defines only FactLocation/SourceLocation/ExampleLocation.

questions.text: What happens when a guest GetSecret or PutSecret uses an invalid secret name or a write fails, given PutSecret returns () and SecretError has only SecretNotFound?
questions.reason: Fixes the guest algebra result types and broker behaviour; 0009 says 'Validate secret names at the host boundary' and 'Secret storage failures ... remain invocation failures', but not how an invalid name is reported.
